records.mitigation: Review available vendor security updates, apply them through the supported distribution package manager, and verify installation using your normal change-management process.
Refresh security update information using the distribution's package manager before relying on update results; investigate inaccessible or expired repositories.
Verify that the operating system, architecture, and relevant packages remain supported; plan a supported release upgrade or establish applicable extended maintenance.
Prefer phishing-resistant multifactor authentication for administrative access and review identity-management controls.
Maintain protected, offline backup copies and test restoration procedures regularly.
